# Built-in site database

*Generated by `tools/gen_site_reference.py` from the `sites` list in `config/config.yaml`; edit that
file, not this page.*

The executable embeds these 36 entries. An override `config.yaml` can change any field of an
entry (matched by name, case-insensitively) or append new entries – see
[how to add or edit a site](../how-to/add-a-site.md).

- **Name** is the label in the dropdown, the slot header and the exported file name.
- **Aliases** are extra spellings the fuzzy search matches (`ig` → Instagram); the name itself always
  matches.
- **Hosts** are domain suffixes: a pasted URL whose host equals one of them, or ends in `.` + one of
  them, selects the site automatically (longest suffix wins). An empty list means never auto-detected.
- **Notes** are what the site typically does to uploads, shown when you hover a site name. They describe
  behaviour observed in 2026 and change without notice; the measured numbers are the truth.

| # | Name | Aliases | Hosts | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Instagram | `ig`, `insta`, `gram`, `instagram` | `instagram.com`, `cdninstagram.com`, `instagram.fbcdn.net` | Feed images are resized to 1080 px on the long side (1080x1080, 1080x1350 or 1080x566), re-encoded as JPEG (roughly q70-80, 4:2:0) with metadata stripped; stories/reels are transcoded to H.264 around 1080x1920. |
| 1 | Facebook | `fb`, `facebook`, `meta` | `facebook.com`, `fbcdn.net`, `fbsbx.com`, `fb.com` | Photos are capped at 2048 px (720/960/2048 variants) and re-encoded as JPEG around q70-85; PNGs are usually converted to JPEG. Videos are transcoded to H.264 with a bitrate cap that depends on resolution. |
| 2 | Threads | `threads`, `meta threads` | `threads.net`, `threads.com` | Shares Instagram's pipeline: 1080 px long side JPEG, metadata stripped; served from cdninstagram.com hosts. |
| 3 | X (Twitter) | `x`, `twitter`, `tweet`, `twtr`, `x.com` | `x.com`, `twitter.com`, `twimg.com`, `t.co` | Images above 4096 px are downscaled, most uploads are re-encoded as JPEG (q~85, 4:2:0) or served as WebP; PNGs with transparency may be kept as PNG. Videos are transcoded to H.264 (several bitrate ladders, 1080p max). |
| 4 | TikTok | `tiktok`, `tt`, `douyin` | `tiktok.com`, `tiktokcdn.com`, `tiktokcdn-us.com`, `tiktokv.com`, `musical.ly` | Videos are transcoded to H.264/H.265 at up to 1080p with aggressive bitrate targets; cover images become JPEG/WebP. |
| 5 | YouTube | `yt`, `youtube`, `youtu.be`, `shorts` | `youtube.com`, `youtu.be`, `ytimg.com`, `ggpht.com`, `googlevideo.com` | Videos are re-encoded into AVC/VP9/AV1 ladders (144p-4K); thumbnails are JPEG/WebP around q80 at 1280x720 max. |
| 6 | Reddit | `reddit`, `rdt`, `redd.it`, `subreddit` | `reddit.com`, `redd.it`, `redditmedia.com`, `redditstatic.com`, `reddituploads.com` | Original images are kept up to 20 MB but previews are re-encoded (JPEG/WebP, downscaled); v.redd.it videos are transcoded to DASH H.264. |
| 7 | Discord | `discord`, `dc`, `discordapp` | `discord.com`, `discordapp.com`, `discordapp.net`, `discord.gg` | Files below the upload cap are stored untouched; media.discordapp.net previews are resized/converted to WebP on the fly (look at the ?format=&width= query). |
| 8 | LinkedIn | `linkedin`, `li`, `licdn` | `linkedin.com`, `licdn.com`, `lnkd.in` | Images are re-encoded as JPEG with multiple sizes (up to ~1280-1920 px long side); videos are transcoded to H.264 720p/1080p. |
| 9 | Pinterest | `pinterest`, `pin`, `pinimg` | `pinterest.com`, `pinimg.com`, `pin.it` | Pins are stored at up to 1200-2000 px on the long side (originals/736x/564x variants) as JPEG q~80 or WebP. |
| 10 | Bluesky | `bluesky`, `bsky`, `blue sky`, `at proto` | `bsky.app`, `bsky.social`, `bsky.network`, `atproto.com` | Uploads are limited to ~1 MB; images are downscaled to 2000 px and re-encoded as JPEG (feed thumbnails are WebP from cdn.bsky.app). |
| 11 | Mastodon | `mastodon`, `fediverse`, `masto` | `mastodon.social`, `mastodon.online`, `mstdn.social`, `mas.to`, `fosstodon.org`, `hachyderm.io` | Default server settings shrink images to ~1920x1080 (2 MP) JPEG q~85 and cap video size/bitrate; each instance can differ. |
| 12 | WhatsApp | `whatsapp`, `wa`, `whats app` | `whatsapp.com`, `whatsapp.net` | Standard image sends are downscaled to ~1600 px long side and re-encoded as JPEG (q~70-80); 'HD' keeps more resolution. Videos are heavily transcoded. |
| 13 | Telegram | `telegram`, `tg`, `tele` | `telegram.org`, `t.me`, `telegram.me`, `telesco.pe`, `telegra.ph` | Photos sent as photos are resized to 1280 px long side JPEG q~87; 'send as file' keeps the original. Videos are re-encoded unless sent as files. |
| 14 | Snapchat | `snapchat`, `snap` | `snapchat.com`, `sc-cdn.net`, `snap.com` | Snaps and stories are re-encoded (JPEG / H.264) at phone resolution; saved media differs from what viewers receive. |
| 15 | Signal | `signal`, `signal messenger` | `signal.org` | Standard quality resizes to ~1600 px and re-encodes as JPEG; 'High' quality keeps ~3072 px. No public CDN URLs. |
| 16 | Messenger | `messenger`, `fb messenger`, `facebook messenger` | `messenger.com` | Uses Facebook's image pipeline (2048 px max, JPEG re-encode) unless files are sent as attachments. |
| 17 | Tumblr | `tumblr`, `tmblr` | `tumblr.com`, `media.tumblr.com`, `tmblr.co` | Images are served in size ladders (up to 2048 px) as JPEG/WebP; GIFs are size-capped. |
| 18 | Imgur | `imgur`, `imgr` | `imgur.com`, `imgur.io` | Large JPEGs are re-encoded and images above ~20 MB are downscaled; animated GIFs become MP4/GIFV. |
| 19 | Flickr | `flickr`, `flkr` | `flickr.com`, `staticflickr.com`, `flic.kr` | Originals can be kept (Pro) while display sizes (Large 1024/1600/2048) are re-encoded JPEG q~90. |
| 20 | 500px | `500px`, `five hundred px` | `500px.com`, `500px.org` | Display versions are re-encoded JPEG at 2048 px; originals are not served publicly. |
| 21 | VSCO | `vsco` | `vsco.co` | Images are re-encoded as JPEG at up to ~2048 px with metadata stripped. |
| 22 | Behance | `behance`, `be` | `behance.net` | Project images are re-encoded (JPEG/WebP) with responsive size ladders up to 1400/2800 px. |
| 23 | ArtStation | `artstation`, `as` | `artstation.com` | Images are re-encoded JPEG (large/medium/small ladders); 4K originals are downscaled. |
| 24 | DeviantArt | `deviantart`, `da`, `dA` | `deviantart.com`, `wixmp.com`, `deviantart.net` | Served through Wix media - resized JPEG/WebP ladders with quality parameters in the URL. |
| 25 | Slack | `slack` | `slack.com`, `slack-files.com`, `slack-edge.com` | Originals are kept for download; inline previews are resized/re-encoded thumbnails. |
| 26 | Microsoft Teams | `teams`, `ms teams`, `microsoft teams` | `teams.microsoft.com`, `sharepoint.com` | Pasted images are re-encoded; attached files are kept in SharePoint/OneDrive untouched. |
| 27 | Google Photos | `google photos`, `gphotos`, `photos` | `photos.google.com`, `googleusercontent.com`, `photos.app.goo.gl` | 'Storage saver' re-encodes at 16 MP / 1080p; 'Original quality' keeps files. Shared links serve resized JPEG/WebP. |
| 28 | iMessage | `imessage`, `apple messages`, `messages` | `icloud.com` | Photos are sent close to original unless 'Low Quality Image Mode' is on; videos are transcoded to a smaller HEVC/H.264. |
| 29 | WeChat | `wechat`, `weixin` | `wechat.com`, `qpic.cn`, `weixin.qq.com` | Images are downscaled and re-encoded as JPEG/WebP unless sent as 'original'; videos are compressed strongly. |
| 30 | Weibo | `weibo`, `sina` | `weibo.com`, `sinaimg.cn`, `weibo.cn` | Images are re-encoded JPEG in size ladders (large/mw1024/bmiddle...). |
| 31 | VK | `vk`, `vkontakte` | `vk.com`, `userapi.com`, `vk.me` | Images are re-encoded JPEG with several sizes up to ~2560 px; videos transcoded to H.264 ladders. |
| 32 | Medium | `medium` | `medium.com`, `miro.medium.com` | Images are re-encoded and resized on the fly (WebP/JPEG) via the miro.medium.com CDN parameters. |
| 33 | Substack | `substack` | `substack.com`, `substackcdn.com` | Images are re-encoded through an image CDN (WebP/JPEG, width/quality parameters in the URL). |
| 34 | Lemmy / Pixelfed | `lemmy`, `pixelfed`, `kbin` | `lemmy.world`, `lemmy.ml`, `pixelfed.social` | Instance-dependent: pict-rs / Pixelfed typically re-encode uploads as JPEG/WebP with a resolution cap. |
| 35 | Other / custom | `other`, `custom`, `unknown`, `website`, `blog` | – | Any other site or messaging app. The measured numbers still tell you exactly what it did. |
